task.description: Hard gate on TEST-DESIGNER's output for REQ-418 (checkout feature/WF02-REQ418-20260927, pull to get commits c132c20d/4ece9556). Verify every one of REQ-418's 8 acceptance criteria has a runnable, correctly-targeted test: 5 pre-existing unit tests from ELIXIR-DEV (AC1, AC2, AC5, AC6, AC7) plus the 2 new live-Keycloak tests in test/letflow/integration/keycloak_mobile_client_auth_test.exs (AC3, AC4) -- cross-check test/specs/REQ-418.md's mapping against the actual test files rather than trusting the doc. Confirm the new file correctly follows the @moduletag :keycloak / async: false / setup_all-reachability convention from test/letflow/integration/keycloak_auth_pipeline_test.exs (no invented {:skip, ...} return, no new HTTP dependency). result.summary: Verified all 8 of REQ-418's acceptance criteria (cross-checked directly against docs/requirements.yaml lines 31106-31114, not just test/specs/REQ-418.md's own claims) each map to a real, non-placeholder test. AC1/AC2 -> test/letflow/api/keycloak_realm_mobile_client_test.exs (11 static assertions on the letflow-mobile client's shape + 2 wildcard-guard/letflow-web-byte-identical assertions; confirmed against the actual priv/keycloak/realms/bpm-default.json client objects, not just the spec's description). AC3/AC4 -> the new test/letflow/integration/keycloak_mobile_client_auth_test.exs: AC3a asserts HTTP 200 + text/html content-type; AC3b asserts non-200, no Location header naming evil.example, and body names redirect_uri; AC3c branches on the two AC-permitted response shapes and asserts specific content for whichever occurred -- none of the three is a vague succeeds/fails check. AC4 asserts both "letflow-web" in aud_list AND azp == "letflow-mobile" as two distinct assertions. AC5/AC6/AC7 -> test/letflow/routers/mobile_tenant_config_test.exs's REQ-418 describe blocks (six-key exact-shape equality across all four never-error paths, client_id default/env-override/cross-path-identity tests, moduledoc refute/assert substring checks) -- all real, none stubbed. AC8 is the process gate, already satisfied per step-02c/step-02d PASS handoffs. Confirmed the new file's @moduletag :keycloak, async: false, and setup_all `raise "Keycloak not ready..."` reachability check exactly mirror keycloak_auth_pipeline_test.exs's established convention (no invented {:skip, ...}). git diff main...HEAD -- mix.exs mix.lock is empty: no new HTTP dependency added; the new file reuses test/support/keycloak_test_client.ex's ensure_started/0, discovery_reachable?/1, direct_access_token/4 and raw :httpc for its two file-specific raw calls, per its own moduledoc rationale. Test isolation: the new file makes no DB calls and mutates no Application.get_env state (unlike keycloak_auth_pipeline_test.exs's setup override of :letflow, :oidc, which is installed/restored within its own on_exit); both files are async: false, and ExUnit serializes all async: false Cases relative to each other regardless of module, so no race exists even if both ran under one --include keycloak invocation. Reproduced `MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force` myself: "Compiling 308 files (.ex) / Generated letflow app", matching the spec's quoted output exactly.
